name: WAVES sign zone
notes: The area around a menu sign (10 px on every side of it): while the monster is in it, 'spot' holds the sign's number, so its name shows over the monster's head and A or B know what to do (plr_menu); leaving it puts 'spot' back to 0. For the WAVES sign (there once all 9 monsters are freed): 'spot' 3. It also sets 'entry' to the chosen monster's waves run (9 + its number) and 'near', so the bottom line of the screen shows that monster's waves best time; leaving clears 'near'. Placed with the sign only when the waves mode is open.
